scope:
T3: CR-5 true-glass band, setpoint caps, and passive C1 latch coverage.

Reuse the unmodified leak_checks and rim_limit apparatus. No board values or
firmware thresholds change. --check rebuilds the C library and regenerates
every result before comparing the complete JSON with the committed bytes.

assumptions.band_centre_definition: arithmetic midpoint, not the nominal comparator trip
assumptions.control_basis: committed simulated benign maximum 246.5 C and reported margin 15.8 K; analytic hold envelope reported separately at 245.1 C
assumptions.hazard_definition: LC.run_case untripped last-100-s mean T_c rounded to 0.1 C > 300 C
assumptions.stopped_definition: passive latch or true glass crossing strictly before first T_c > 300; ideal immediate cut, no cooldown or stored-energy model
assumptions.cold_soak: not credited: these leaks start during the cook at LC.LEAK_AT

cohorts.control_sweep: LC.leak_cases at cap 250: original offsets 12/46 K, hot/cold bead, tau 60 s, rail 3300 mV
cohorts.nominal: same cases/seeds as sweep hot-bead slots, bead R25/B nominal, rail 3300 mV, tau 60 s; both offsets
cohorts.worst_corner: RL.stress_leak: envelope and flat cool-eye glass, cold bead + rail 3367 mV, tau 106 s
cohorts.offset_worst_corner: same cases/seeds as sweep cold-bead slots, fixed offset 12 or 46 K, cold bead + rail 3367 mV, tau 106 s

assumptions.commands: all es.PANS setpoints clamped at cap; LC.SP_FRY=cap; water retains 90/100 C
assumptions.benign_initial_glass: LC fixed starts retained, including 200 C glass; RL hot_glass reset to rounded Tg_max(cap); benign maxima include initial Tg
